baseline.same_request_failure: Both isolated supplier and owned return HTTP500 / ORA-00904 PROJECTNO for the original ext$.projectno_CISC quick filter under matching principal, organization and roles.
baseline.stock_resource_comparison: Original audited-analysis JavaScript and both project Oracle mapper XML files match the approved stock artifact after line-ending normalization.
baseline.scope: This corrects an original UI contract. It is not classified as a reconstructed framework regression or a strict API pass.

original_source_chain: original Grid header filter setHeadRequestData appends CISC to the actual UI column field
pf-project-oracle-mapper.xml selectAnalysisAuditProject projects T_EMC_PROJECT A.* and B.BIZCATEGORYNAME
GenericService.selectPagination maps projected rows to EmcProjectBean

row_activation.reason: The project query exposes its primary key as id. It does not project projId. Passing undefined drops the intended project scope from the child run query.

unresolved_order_category.reason: The active PfProjectMapper does not project report category, and EmcProjectBean has no orderCategory. The earlier base mapper joins T_EMC_REPORT, but restoring that one-to-many join would change shared query cardinality and totals for several consumers. This repair does not make that business choice.
unresolved_order_category.actual_grid_contract: Original Grid header renders no editor when column.filter === false. Original Grid.sort emits no ordering when column.sort === false. search:false is not used because it does not control these Grid operations.

preserved_contracts: original pagination and sorting for the six supported fields
original query URL and original Mapper SQL
original urgent indicator and column labels
GlobalMapper filtering and all Java implementations

regression.before: 0/4 assertions pass: original column projection, actual header controls, CISC keys and selected project ID all fail.
regression.after: 4/4 assertions pass using actual current chunk-common header render, filter-key generation and sort methods plus the actual page callback.
regression.limits: VM tests simulate Vue DOM/child readiness collaborators. They are not browser or real HTTP evidence.

read_only_HTTP_validation.checkpoint_application: Existing unmodified source-only API; this change only corrects UI requests and was not deployed during validation.
read_only_HTTP_validation.identity: Supplier and owned principal, organization and roles matched through real current-account reads.

original_page_profile.requests: Default plus each of six corrected CISC no-match filters, once per side: 14 HTTP query requests.
original_page_profile.result: Both sides HTTP200, total0, rows[] for all profiles; no ORA-00904.
original_page_profile.positive_data: Blocked: the original auditQuery profile has no matching rows. Empty equivalence is not positive behavior coverage.

independent_source_projection_profile.scope: Explicit separate read-only profile preserving org_filter while omitting the auditQuery status filter. No status or fixture was written.
independent_source_projection_profile.requests: Two existing-project reads, six actual-value CISC probes per side and one page2/size1/descending probe per side: 16 HTTP query requests.
independent_source_projection_profile.result: Both sides expose91 organization-scoped projects; common real sample fields match. Each six-field actual-value probe returns exactly the same existing entity with total1. Page2/size1 returns one row. Actual response lacks orderCategory, confirming the separate model gap.
independent_source_projection_profile.limits: This demonstrates the existing query supports the corrected six fields and pagination. It is not a positive replay of the original auditQuery page state, deployed UI acceptance or strict evidence.

related_equipment_findings.DTO_ledger_queries: Three equipment summary endpoints assign displayed equiptNo only after pagination. Their child queries use equipment foreign keys, so renaming equiptNo to equiptId would compare a display code with a numeric FK and corrupt filter semantics.
related_equipment_findings.period_check_plan: The plan UI calls a record resource while the intended plan Mapper projects CODENAME. This is a different entity/route contract and cannot be fixed by this project's field mapping.
related_equipment_findings.disposition: Keep those original failures separately attributed; do not rewrite controllers or globally translate field names.
